files.caption: Two photographs of 1810 Tytus Avenue, Middletown, Ohio. Photographs are undated. The real estate listing for 1810 Tytus Avenue reads: 1800 Block: Seven-room modern residence in excellent condition. First floor has reception hall, living room with fireplace, large dining room and kitchen. Three large bedrooms, hall and bath on second floor. New furnace. Two-car garage. Nice rear yard, all fenced. Call now for interior inspection.
